description: Asserts projection_rebuild_attempts mechanics: after projection_integrity becomes 'stale', increment projection_rebuild_attempts up to PROJECTION_REBUILD_MAX_ATTEMPTS (12); at ceiling set projection_integrity='permanently_stale'. REL-r2-9.

transitions.trigger: 12th consecutive rebuild failure triggers permanent stale

assertions.description: projection_rebuild_attempts is NOT NULL and defaults to 0
assertions.sql: SELECT projection_rebuild_attempts FROM output_contract_repair_events WHERE repair_attempt_id = 'X'

assertions.description: projection_integrity CHECK constraint rejects invalid values
permanently_stale is a terminal state — no further rebuild attempts
